# Synthetic harness fixtures

Generated by `python -m agdash.devtools.fixture_kit` from the harness files of
one macOS machine. The structure of every record is kept; every prompt, reply,
thought, path, identifier, account and secret is replaced with synthetic
content, and every date is shifted by one fixed offset. Nothing here is real
session data.

The Codex `archived_sessions/` file is a copy of one rollout placed there by the
kit, because the source machine had no archived sessions when it ran.
